text: @kinocode/dsh-lcu 是面向 DSH 桌面端的 LCU（Codex computer use）MCP 适配插件。它把 LCU 挂载为名为 lcu 的 MCP 服务，并由适配器处理应用操作请求，让 DSH 代理可调用 js 和 js_reset 工具操作 macOS 原生应用。适配器可按配置询问是否允许应用操作，也可设置为自动允许或拒绝；截图会保存为文件并返回路径。适合希望在 DSH 中使用 LCU 控制桌面应用的 macOS 用户。需要安装 LCU、ChatGPT 桌面应用和 Node.js，并配置系统辅助功能与屏幕录制权限；代码未显示需要 API 密钥。

@kinocode/dsh-lcu connects LCU to DSH through an MCP adapter. It exposes js and js_reset for operating macOS apps, handles configurable app approvals, and saves screenshots as files. Requires macOS, LCU, the ChatGPT desktop app, Node.js, Accessibility, and Screen Recording.
想让 DSH 通过 LCU 操作 macOS 上的桌面应用。
能不能把电脑使用能力接成 MCP 工具，并在操作应用前弹出确认？
I want my DSH agent to control native Mac apps through LCU tools.
@kinocode/dsh-lcu 的功能「通过 MCP 使用 LCU」：插件启动适配器并连接本机 LCU 服务，只向 DSH 暴露 js 与 js_reset 工具，供代理调用来操作 macOS 应用。
@kinocode/dsh-lcu 的功能「应用操作确认与截图返回」：收到 LCU 的应用操作请求时可按 ask、all 或 deny 配置处理；LCU 返回的截图会写入临时目录，并以文件路径文本返回。

@kinocode/dsh-lcu README · @kinocode/dsh-lcu：[日本語](README.ja.md) | English

[LCU](https://github.com/amontlabs/lcu) (Codex computer use, decoupled from the Codex app) as a
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin. The agent gets
`mcp__lcu__js` / `mcp__lcu__js_reset` to read and operate native macOS apps.

@kinocode/dsh-lcu README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @kinocode/dsh-lcu
```
Restart DSH and start a new session. Other LCU location: set `prefix` (below) or `LCU_PREFIX`.

@kinocode/dsh-lcu README · Approval modes：Set in your profile patch:
```yaml
- id: lcu
  config:
    approval: ask      # ask (default) | all | deny
```
| `approval` | Behavior |
|---|---|
| `ask` | A macOS dialog asks you: Deny / Allow this time / Always allow (Touch ID, same as `lcu apps allow`). Closed, timed out, or answered faster than a human → denied |
| `all` | Approve every app without asking |
| `deny` | Always deny |

@kinocode/dsh-lcu README · Approval modes：In every mode the adapter refuses apps the agent could use to approve itself: DSH, terminals, Claude,
`osascript` / System Events. Other config: `prefix`, `toolCallTimeoutMs`.

@kinocode/dsh-lcu README · What the adapter does：- Exposes only `js` and `js_reset` (host-only tools such as `turn_ended` are hidden)
- Saves screenshots as files under `$TMPDIR/dsh-lcu-shots/` and returns the path (view with `read_image`),
  because the MCP client turns images into placeholders
- Reconnects to LCU on the next call if it exits
